name: hoverlab
description: Install UI from the Hoverlab catalog — CSS effects, React blocks, whole pages, and scaffoldable project templates — and expose them to your editor's AI agent over MCP.
//: Intentionally dependency-free. `npx hoverlab add btn-gradient` should be one round-trip to npm and one to the API — every dependency added here is latency a user feels before they get their effect. This is also why `init` reads a template as JSON rather than unzipping the archive the website serves.
